comment: v7 genre-shard manifest: a layer is a WORLD (prepped alone, poisoning nothing); the glue is dead (links 1150→620 measured). The layered state (frozen base + genre sessions) turns these worlds into one mind; until the L-1 seam lands, each world answers its own tiers. Each world declares its TEXT KIND: «shows» is generated show-material whose every claim is checkable, «prose» is essay corpus where a hyphen lives inside a name, a power lives in a superscript and a falsehood may be QUOTED to be refuted. A judge calibrated on shows produces false accusations on prose, so jurisdiction is declared, not assumed.

worlds.name: money
worlds.genre: money in CENTS and the bridge to the decimal writing (e9's order 04.09, band g1: 15 of 65 problems carry «$16.50», and the organism is honestly mute on decimals): prices, sums, multiples and change counted in whole cents and kopecks — «a pen costs 250 cents and a book costs 375 cents. how much do they cost together? 250 + 375 = 625 cents.», «ann paid 1000 cents for a book that costs 625 cents. how much change did ann get? 1000 − 625 = 375 cents.», «ручка стоит 250 копеек, а книга стоит 375 копеек; вместе они стоят 625 копеек: 250 + 375 = 625.»; the decimal price is shown as a BRIDGE with its ledger («16.50 dollars is 1650 cents: 16 × 100 = 1600, 1600 + 50 = 1650.», «16 рублей 50 копеек — это 1650 копеек: …») and a sum in dollars carries the same sum in cents as its witness («16.50 + 2.50 = 19.00 dollars: 1650 + 250 = 1900 cents»); the answer opens with the question's first quantity; the court reads dollars and cents from the decimal writing itself, recomputes every link, and checks the kopeck and rouble forms by the house of forms and the names by the packs

worlds.name: money_langs
worlds.genre: MONEY WITH THE DECIMAL COMMA in nine languages (the owner's word: every language in surplus; the money world wrote «16.50 dollars»/«$16.50» and «16 рублей 50 копеек» — Europe writes the comma): the bridge «16,50 Euro sind 1650 Cent: 16 × 100 = 1600, 1600 + 50 = 1650.» / «16,50 euros font 1650 centimes : …» / «16,50 euros son 1650 céntimos: …» / «16,50 euro sono 1650 centesimi: …» / «16,50 euros são 1650 cêntimos: …» / «16,50 euro is 1650 cent: …» / «16,50 zł to 1650 groszy: …» / «16,50 lira 1650 kuruştur: …» / «16,50 рубля — это 1650 копеек: …», the question of the small unit («wie viel Cent sind 16,50 Euro? 16 × 100 = 1600, 1600 + 50 = 1650 Cent.», «¿cuántos céntimos son …?», «ile groszy to …?», «… kaç kuruştur?», «сколько копеек в …?»), the way back («1650 Cent sind 16,50 Euro: 16 × 100 = 1600, 1650 − 1600 = 50.») and the sum with its witness in cents («7,10 Euro + 4,40 Euro = 11,50 Euro: 710 + 440 = 1150 Cent.»); the house of money writings (tools/moneyforms.py) declares the units with their count forms (Polish grosz/grosze/groszy by the pack's count_agreement, Russian by the house of forms, German and Dutch invariable), the copulas and the questions; the court reads the same table, reads the decimal writing as (whole, cents) with two digits of cents and recomputes every link and count form

worlds.name: money_story
worlds.genre: STORIES OF MONEY IN THREE LANGUAGES (e9's order 03.09, the organ of money): «tom has $5.20. he spends $1.50. how much money does he have now? 520 − 150 = 370 cents. 370 cents is $3.70.» — the verbs of money with their signs (spends/spent, pays/paid — minus; earns/earned, saves/saved — plus) in two holdings (has/holds), ten pages per verb form on ten different decimals; the act with a price («he buys a pen for $1.50» — the number after «for»); «money» as the asked head («how much money does tom have? tom has $5.20.», «how much money is left?»); the same in Russian (у Тома 5 рублей 20 копеек / Том имеет …; тратит, потратил(а), платит, заплатил(а), зарабатывает, заработал(а), откладывает, отложил(а); покупает ручку за …; сколько денег у него теперь? / осталось? / у Тома?) and German (hat / besitzt; gibt … aus, gab … aus, bezahlt(e), verdient(e), spart(e); kauft einen Stift für …; wie viel Geld hat er jetzt? / bleibt übrig? / hat Tom?), the ledger in cents/копейках/Cent and the bridge back to the decimal writing; the house of money stories (tools/moneystory.py) holds the templates, the court reads them back and REGENERATES the page letter by letter

worlds.name: relations_story
worlds.genre: A MULTIPLE, A DIFFERENCE AND A SUM — SCHOOL PAGES IN THREE LANGUAGES (e9's order 03.09, G1-ATTACK genus 1 «multiplicative relation + sum», 21 tasks of g1): «there are twice as many worker bees as baby bees. there are 750 bees in all. how many baby bees are there? 1 + 2 = 3, 750 ÷ 3 = 250. so the answer is 250.» (the larger part asked with «× k», the same fact as «half as many / a third as many»), «bobby has 5 fewer than three times as many games as brian. brian has 20 games. how many games does bobby have? 3 × 20 = 60, 60 − 5 = 55. so the answer is 55.», backwards «janey has 3 more than twice the number of books sally has. janey has 21 books. how many books does sally have? 21 − 3 = 18, 18 ÷ 2 = 9. so the answer is 9.», ages «ruby is three times as old as sam. sam is 4 years old. how old is ruby? 3 × 4 = 12.», «… together they are 32 years old. how old is sam? 1 + 3 = 4, 32 ÷ 4 = 8.», the g1 idiom «three times older than»; ru («рабочих пчёл вдвое больше, чем молодых пчёл. всего пчёл 750. сколько молодых пчёл? …», «у Анны на 5 игр меньше, чем утроенное число игр у Ани. у Ани 20 игр. …», «Анна втрое старше Ани. Ане 4 года. сколько лет Анне? …») and de («es gibt doppelt so viele Arbeiterbienen wie junge Bienen. insgesamt sind es 750 Bienen. …», «Anna hat 5 Spiele weniger als dreimal so viele wie Jonas. …», «Anna ist dreimal so alt wie Jonas. zusammen sind sie 32 Jahre alt. …»); whole answers (the sum a multiple of 1 + k), every step a primitive, the last number the answer; the house of relation pages (tools/relstory.py) holds the templates, the court reads them back and REGENERATES the page letter by letter

worlds.name: shares_percent
worlds.genre: SHARES AND PERCENTS OVER QUANTITIES — GENUS 2 OF THE g1 BAND (holon's word 03.09, G1-ATTACK): five forms whose ledger is a chain of primitives whole on the axis, en/ru/de — «what is two thirds of 24? two thirds of 24 is 16: 24 ÷ 3 = 8, 8 × 2 = 16.» (denominators 2..10 and numerators in words, ONE frame for every word of the fraction), «what is 40 percent of 220? 40 percent of 220 is 88: 220 × 40 = 8800, 8800 ÷ 100 = 88.» (the hundred divided last, never a fraction on the axis), the complement «three quarters of the pupils have a pen; 20 do not. how many pupils are there? 20 is one quarter of 80: 4 − 3 = 1, 20 ÷ 1 = 20, 20 × 4 = 80.», the number from its share «two thirds of a number is 16. what is the number? 16 is two thirds of 24: 16 ÷ 2 = 8, 8 × 3 = 24.», the number from its percent «12 is 40 percent of what number? 12 is 40 percent of 30: 12 × 100 = 1200, 1200 ÷ 40 = 30.»; ru («сколько будет две трети от 24? …», «три четверти учеников имеют ручку; 20 не имеют. …», «две трети числа равны 16. …» — связка согласована с числителем) and de («was sind zwei Drittel von 24? …», «ein Drittel einer Zahl ist 12. …» — the share takes its article); the house of share and percent phrases (tools/fracforms.py) reads its templates through tools/phrases.py, the court reads the fraction word back to its numbers and recomputes

worlds.name: chains_langs
worlds.genre: A CHAIN OF TWO AND THREE STEPS IN TWENTY-NINE LANGUAGES (the owner's word: every language in surplus): nineteen declared languages (am, ar, el, fa, fi, he, hi, hu, id, ja, ka, ko, sv, sw, ta, th, uk, vi, zh) carried lexicon and single equalities only and NOT ONE CHAIN — the form the market of reasoning buys (holon, ONE-CARRIER: the ledger is the program is the proof). «九加四等于十三。 十三减九等于四。», «六 足す 十二 は 十八. 十八 引く 一 は 十七.», «шість плюс дванадцять дорівнює вісімнадцять. вісімнадцять мінус один дорівнює сімнадцять.», «tisa jumlisha nne ni sawa na kumi na tatu. kumi na tatu toa tisa ni sawa na nne.», «bốn mươi cộng hai mươi bằng sáu mươi. sáu mươi trừ mười bằng năm mươi. năm mươi nhân hai bằng một trăm.» — two steps of (+, −) and (×, +), and chains of THREE steps; NOT ONE NEW WORD is invented: the house of chains (tools/chainforms.py) reads the TEMPLATES each pack declares in show_kinds.arithmetic, tells the operation by the PLACE of the holes, and fills them with the pack's own numerals — a number the language does not declare is never said; the court reads the same templates back, recounts every step and checks the SEAM (the number leaving a step is an operand of the next) — and the SEARCH WITHOUT A PREDICATE (the collegium's task 2, way «б» chosen by holon 03.09): a walk over consecutive candidates, each rejected by its own witness and the last standing beside one («3 × 3 = 9. 2 × 5 = 10. 1 × 11 = 11.»), so that a pack that never declared the word «prime» still shows the search; the court knows both kinds of chain — the ledger, whose seam holds, and the search, whose results run consecutively

worlds.name: action_pages
worlds.genre: A LEDGER FOR EVERY COUNTABLE ACT — NEW PAGES, OLD WORLDS UNTOUCHED (the collegium of a hundred per cent, owner 03.09; holon's first task, e9's condition «add new pages, do not rewrite old ones»): the reader's worlds answer computable questions with a value («peter keeps 4 coins»), and their form may not change because his markets buy skeletons from those lines; so the same genera come again WITH THE CHAIN, in en/ru/de — the remainder «peter had 8 coins. peter gave 4 coins away. how many coins are left? 8 − 4 = 4. so the answer is 4.», the increase «nick had 9 balls. nick got 2 balls more. … 9 + 2 = 11.», the share that went «у Анны было 70 книг. половина книг ушла. сколько книг осталось? 70 ÷ 2 = 35, 70 − 35 = 35.» and «две трети книг ушли … 60 ÷ 3 = 20, 20 × 2 = 40, 60 − 40 = 20.» (the words of the fractions from the house of shares, the Russian verb agreeing with the numerator), the two bearers «elena has 2 children. ava has 3 children. how many children do they have together? 2 + 3 = 5.», the multiple «Anna hat 2 Eier. Jonas hat dreimal so viele Eier wie Anna. … 3 × 2 = 6.»; ≥ 15 pages per genus and language; the house (tools/actionpages.py) holds the templates, the court regenerates the page letter by letter

worlds.name: two_kinds
worlds.genre: TWO KINDS AND A SUM OF WEIGHTS — THE SYSTEM OF TWO UNKNOWNS WITH ITS CHAIN (e9's order 03.09, the profile of muteness of the g1 band, genus 5): the band asked «there are 20 animals … 70 legs, how many cows?» and the organism was mute not for the arithmetic but because no page ever said how many legs a cow has. This world says it: «there are 20 animals in a farm, chickens and cows. a chicken has 2 legs and a cow has 4 legs. there are 70 legs in all. how many cows are there? 2 × 20 = 40, 70 − 40 = 30, 4 − 2 = 2, 30 ÷ 2 = 15. so the answer is 15.» — the chain is the substitution written out (all of the lesser kind would give 2 × 20 legs; the surplus is bought by swaps, each swap adding 4 − 2), and the lesser kind asked adds one step (20 − 15 = 5). Three pairs per language (chickens and cows, bicycles and cars, beetles and spiders — the lesser kind always carries the lesser weight, or the chain would run through negative numbers), en/ru/de («на ферме 20 животных, куриц и коров. у курицы 2 ноги, а у коровы 4 ноги. всего 70 ног. сколько коров? …», «es gibt 20 Tiere in einem Hof, Hühner und Kühe. ein Huhn hat 2 Beine und eine Kuh hat 4 Beine. …»); the house of two kinds (tools/twokinds.py) declares every count form it uses, the court solves the system itself and regenerates the page

worlds.name: genus_diff
worlds.genre: DEFINITIONS BY GENUS AND DIFFERENCE — THE GENUS, THE DIFFERENCE AND FOUR QUESTIONS OF ONE FACT IN ONE LINE (the measure of the shelf, 03.09: «связка без числа» — a copula without a number — is fourteen per cent of the sentences of books, the largest kind of prose no house of the corpus had ever written; holon named the shape). Every show is one line holding «утверждение. вопрос? ответ.», as in the world of inquiry, so the market of the copula buys the FACT from the statement and the form of the ANSWER only from the question→answer pair standing beside it: «a pen is a tool that writes. what is a pen? a tool that writes.», «… is a pen a tool or an animal? a tool.», «… what does a pen do? a pen writes.», «… which tool writes? a pen.» Four questions of one fact, and their answers cover every role of it: the whole predicate, the genus alone, the difference alone, and the NAME alone — the last is the inversion, where the difference asks and the thing answers. Twenty-three things over nine genera in each of en/ru/de («ручка — это инструмент, который пишет. какой инструмент пишет? ручка.», «ein Stift ist ein Werkzeug, das schreibt. welches Werkzeug schreibt? ein Stift.»); the house (tools/defforms.py) declares every word and every agreement — the relative word agrees with the GENUS and stands beside it, and a thing is singular so that its difference is one verb form both after the genus and after the name. Each distinct line is written ONCE: the lexicon is finite, and repeating it would be weight, not knowledge

worlds.name: unit_counts
worlds.genre: COUNTED UNITS — «1 day, 2 days, 5 days» IN ONE FRAME (32's tomograph of the rate, 03.09): the market of count forms buys the pair «day / days» only inside ONE frame carrying at least three different numbers, and the corpus said «worked on 1 day» in one world and «how much in 8 days» in another — two frames, no pair — so the rate «cynthia collects 10 eggs every day. how many eggs in 8 days?» stayed mute while «in 8 day» answered. Each show says one frame with five counts (1, 2, 3, 5, 10): «the trip takes 1 day. the trip takes 2 days. …», «поездка длится 1 день. поездка длится 2 дня. поездка длится 5 дней.», «die Reise dauert 1 Tag. …» — four frames per language, six units (day, hour, week, month, year, minute), en/ru/de. Every form is DECLARED by the house (tools/countforms.py): English and German name two forms, Russian three, chosen by the last digit under the teenage census («21 день», but «11 дней»); the court judges the agreement and calls «2 day», «5 дня», «1 Tage» lies of the form

worlds.name: joints
worlds.genre: THE JOINT BETWEEN TWO NUMERIC PHRASES — a fan of words in ONE position, and that position with NO word at all (32's number of 04.09). A market may read the joint by POSITION — «the word standing between two numeric phrases of one clause» — before it has bought anything; but a corpus that shows ONE word there teaches the word, not the position, and today the whole svod puts «and» in that place with six translations. This world shows «and / plus / along with / as well as / together with» in the same frame, the comma AND a word in one clause («5 apples, 3 pears and 2 plums»), and the bare list where the position carries no word at all («5 apples, 3 pears, 2 plums»). Seven languages, 24 declared joints; the goods, names and the word for «things» are NOT declared twice — they are read from the action-pages house, two houses on one dictionary.

worlds.name: dialogue
worlds.genre: EVERYDAY SPEECH — the first word a person writes (the owner's order, 04.09). He tried the organism alive and wrote it «привет»; the organism was SILENT, and silent again to «ты не знаешь, что такое привет?». The defect was not in the roads: in the whole svod the number of greetings was EXACTLY ZERO, and a product whose first word cannot be answered has no first word. Nine languages of the attack (ru en de fr es it pt nl pl), five forms, all of them pairs of shows like every other world: the pair of the everyday («привет. здравствуйте.», «спасибо. не за что.» — the reply comes from its OWN list, so the market buys that gratitude is answered differently from how it is given), the definition of the everyday («что такое привет? привет — это приветствие.»), the name with a FAN of questions that ask it, the answer to «кто ты?» — which speaks of the BOUNDARY and not of greatness, and is therefore true — and POLITE IGNORANCE («что такое кваркозавр? я не знаю, что такое кваркозавр.»), the honest answer that silence is not. The name of the organism is declared in ONE line of the house and written in the script of each language.

worlds.name: links
worlds.genre: CONVERSATION LINKS — a question whose subject stands in the PREVIOUS reply (the owner's order, 04.09, item 5; the BESEDA band measures this genus mute 15 of 15). «почему?», «а если наоборот?», «что дальше?», «правда ли?», «согласен ли ты?» — and every link of this house is hooked to a fact with a NUMBER, so that it stays checkable: «согласен ли ты?» about taste is judged by nothing, «согласен ли ты?» about a count is judged by recounting. Seven forms, seven languages, the answer carrying its forge («почему у ани 5 яблок? потому что было 7, а отдано 2: 7 − 2 = 5.»), and BOTH polarities of the truth question — «правда ли это? да» beside «правда ли, что 9? нет, 5», without which the «yes» is worth nothing. Names, goods and their count forms are read from the action-pages house: two houses, one dictionary — hence seven languages and not nine, a named debt.

worlds.name: behavior
worlds.genre: BEHAVIOURAL AND PSYCHOLOGICAL LAWS — the cause of an act and the question about it (the owner's order, 04.09, item 3: «понимать базовые поведенческие и психологические законы»). Not psychology in general and not quotations from the shelf, but shows of this house: six genera named by the order — fatigue → errors, need → action, emotion → its ground, intention → deed, habit → repetition, attention → omission. Every consequence is COMPARATIVE («ошибается ЧАЩЕ», «makes MORE mistakes»): «the tired man errs» is false as a law about a man, «the tired man errs more often» is true as a law about frequency, and the corpus may not teach the first. Three forms: the rule, the QUESTION about the cause, and the law generalized over cases. Nine languages; the subject is always a NAME, never a pronoun, so no referent is ever left hanging.

worlds.name: topics
worlds.genre: EVERYDAY TOPICS — what a person asks about first (the owner's order, 04.09, item 4; the BESEDA band measures this genus mute 16 of 20, and names its cause: SUBJ-UNKNOWN — the reader does not know the SUBJECT of the question. «Что такое дождь?» requires rain to be defined somewhere in the svod, and it was not). Eight topics — weather, time and the calendar, food, the road, work, money in daily life, health, family — in two forms, each checkable in its own way: the DEFINITION («что такое дождь? дождь — это вода, которая падает из облаков.») judged by the declared table, so that the same frame with a FOREIGN definition is a lie; and the COUNT («в сутках 24 часа. сколько часов в сутках? 24 часа.», «в сутках 24 часа, в часе 60 минут. сколько минут в сутках? 1440 минут: 24 × 60 = 1440.») judged by recounting. The languages are divided BY THE NATURE OF THE FORM and not by convenience: the count is held by all nine languages of the attack (numbers do the work, two words per unit), the definitions by five (ru en de fr es) — a definition is a sentence that must be written correctly, not translated by eye, and a language whose definitions are not yet declared does not write them. A named debt.

worlds.name: nature
worlds.genre: NATURE — the counted facts about the living and about things, and temperature (the owner asked for a partner able «to talk on different topics»; the topics house gave definitions and the calendar, this one gives what a person KNOWS about the world and what a child asks about: how many legs a spider has, how many teeth a person has, at what temperature water boils). Every show is CHECKABLE, and doubly: the count form of the thing follows its number (the houses rugram and plgram for the Slavic languages, a declared singular/plural pair for the rest), and the DERIVED show carries its forge — «how many legs do two spiders have? 16 legs: 8 × 2 = 16». The second matters more than the first: a fact of nature that is COUNTED OVER stops being a memorised string and becomes a premise. Nine languages of the attack; the facts are declared, not derived, and every one of them is true about the world.

worlds.name: worldfacts
worlds.genre: WORLD FACTS — why and what next about THINGS, not about numbers. The links house («ann has 5 coins. why? because she had 5 and gave away 1») speaks only over arithmetic facts, and the seven mute lines left in the LINKS-OF-A-TALK genus of the conversation band all had this one nature: a person asks the same conversational moves over facts of the WORLD («water boils at one hundred degrees. why?», «it is raining. what next?», «do you agree that water is wet?»). Six declared facts per language, each with its GROUND and its CONSEQUENCE, plus class membership on its own line, plus the two agreement frames. The shape was agreed with holon BEFORE the world was built and his word changed it twice: the question stands BETWEEN the fact and the ground (a line of two short statements without a number is the frame of his exchange market, and the question mark keeps it out without a single new feature — and, more importantly, «the ground becomes an ANSWER rather than a neighbour: a line without a question teaches juxtaposition, a line with a question teaches transition»), and membership stands on its OWN line, because a fact is checked by observation and a membership by other knowledge. Five languages; the rest is a named debt, by the same law as the definitions of the topics house.

worlds.name: infer
worlds.genre: STRICT INFERENCE — modus ponens, modus tollens, and TWO FALLACIES named as fallacies. The map of reasoning forms (reports/REASONING-2026-09-04.md) named modus tollens the corpus's chief debt: the corpus showed the step from premise to consequence and never the step from the denial of the consequence to the denial of the premise. The debt was named together with its condition: build it not on facts of the world («ice is not seen on the surface → ice does not float» is a strict implication the world does not give) but on a row of conditionals each of which is strict. The row chosen is arithmetic, and it is chosen FOR THE ORACLE: «if a number is divisible by 4, it is divisible by 2» is strict by division, not by declaration, and so every show of this world is checked by RECOUNTING — the court knows nothing of what the house meant to say, and catches a swapped number by counting. The last two forms matter more than the first three: «6 is divisible by 2. does it follow that 6 is divisible by 4? no: 6 is not divisible by 4» shows an INVALID step together with its refutation. A corpus that shows only valid steps teaches a pattern; a corpus that shows an invalid step with its counterexample teaches the difference. The witness of both fallacies is THE SAME number — one observation destroys both wrong steps at once. Nine languages.

worlds.name: opposites
worlds.genre: OPPOSITES — the first relation in the corpus of a WORD TO A WORD, not of a word to a thing, and there was not one show of it in the whole svod. A partner knows not only what a thing IS (the house of definitions) and how much of it there is (the house of nature) but also what it is OPPOSED to. The law that judges this is SYMMETRY: the relation is mutual, and if big is opposed to small then small is opposed to big — both sides stand in the shows, because a corpus that showed one side would teach half a law. The frame is a CITATION frame («what is the opposite of the word big?») and that is a decision, not a convenience: «opposite to BIG» would want a dative in Russian and a genitive in Polish, and every language would want two or three forms per word; the citation frame takes the word in its dictionary form, so the house declares exactly what it knows and invents no case it has not checked. Twelve pairs in each of the nine languages of the attack, three forms.

worlds.name: roles
worlds.genre: ROLE QUESTIONS — a question BY THE TYPE OF ITS HOLE: with what, where, of what. The collegium named Д-1 a generalizing defect: a question is a SURFACE bought from its own genus and not an operation over a fact, and the cure was named there too — an inversion organ, a market of question words BY HOLE TYPE (number, entity, time, place). The holes world holds time, place, entity and number inside a narrative; this house adds three types nobody held: INSTRUMENT («чем пишут? ручкой»), PLACE OF AN ACTION («где покупают хлеб? в магазине»), MATERIAL («из чего сделан стол? из дерева»). The ANSWER is declared as a WHOLE PHRASE, and that is a decision: «ручкой» is an instrumental, «в магазине» a prepositional with its preposition, «из дерева» a genitive with its own — declaring the cases apart would mean three case tables across nine languages and an error in each. The house declares the answer as it sounds, and can err only in what it declared — and what is declared is visible to the eye. The word order of a language lives in the DECLARATION, not in the frame: German and Dutch put the subject right after the verb («wo kauft man Brot?»), and the subject is declared inside the clause where the language keeps it. Nine languages, three hole types.

worlds.name: scale
worlds.genre: THE SCALE — a comparison of THINGS THEMSELVES and TRANSITIVITY as a checkable INFERENCE. The compare world compares the NUMBERS at things («dan has 2 apples more»); here the things themselves are compared — «an elephant is bigger than a dog» — and there is no number at all. Such a comparison cannot be checked by recounting, and that is why it usually does not enter a corpus where every line must be checkable. THE SCALE makes it checkable: the things are declared as an ORDERED row, and every show is a claim about PLACES in that row — «an elephant is bigger than a dog» is true exactly when the elephant stands later. And then what the house was written for becomes possible: TRANSITIVITY — «an elephant is bigger than a horse. a horse is bigger than a person. so an elephant is bigger than a person.» That third line is not a fact about the world but an INFERENCE from two facts, and it is checked by the same row. A corpus that has a checkable inference teaches not only knowledge but the passage from knowledge to knowledge. The comparative agrees with its subject and is therefore declared AT EACH THING, not at the language.

worlds.name: ruverbs
worlds.genre: russian verb frames at the mass of the english ones: present, past with the actor's gender, echo question, sum frame, and anaphora — the missing link of ru-anaphora named by measurement

worlds.name: lang_nl
worlds.genre: dutch: three distinct present cells, not six (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_sv
worlds.genre: swedish: NO person agreement at all — the paradigm is tense (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_pl
worlds.genre: polish: the slavic count law on a latin alphabet, nine diacritics (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_uk
worlds.genre: ukrainian: cyrillic with four letters russian lacks, apostrophe inside the word (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_tr
worlds.genre: turkish: agglutination, vowel harmony in four classes, teens as two words, and NO count agreement — the noun stays singular after a numeral (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: inquiry
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry: for six genera — primality, divisibility, the sum of odd numbers, the conditional, injectivity, the square — four rungs are shown, definition then a decided case with its ground then a counterexample then the law; both tongues, every ground recomputed by the court

worlds.name: surfaces
worlds.genre: the surfaces of an act: the same arithmetic fact said as a nominalisation («сложение 7 и 6 даёт 13», «the addition of 7 and 6 gives 13»), as a named result («сумма … равна», «произведение … равно» — the copula agrees with gender), as a question to each, and with numerals SPOKEN in words («сорок два минус пять будет тридцать семь»); government is declared once and the question is derived from the same phrase it answers

worlds.name: markdown
worlds.genre: markdown in full: thirty-two constructs of CommonMark, GFM and MDX/Docusaurus, each on four surfaces — the record itself, its meaning in English and in Russian, and the question that asks for it; the oracle is REVERSIBILITY (a construct declares how to write it and how to read it, and a construct whose reading does not return what was written never reaches the corpus)

worlds.name: doctree
worlds.genre: document structure: a link is an EDGE and is judged by RESOLUTION against a declared tree — relative paths counted from the document's own folder, anchors into a document, slugification of a heading into an anchor, order by sidebar_position, and links that lead NOWHERE with the ground of the refusal named; the oracle is two opposite walks (build the link text from a pair, resolve the link text back to a pair)

worlds.name: formula_lang
worlds.genre: formula and speech, converted both ways at any depth: ONE expression TREE with four surfaces (LaTeX, glyphs, English words, Russian words) and four inverse walks written apart; a compound argument is always spoken in brackets, which is what makes speech parsable at any depth; the court parses BOTH sides of a conversion and requires the SAME TREE, and the home's oracle proves all eight walks agree on six thousand trees to depth five

worlds.name: percent
worlds.genre: percent on three surfaces (glyph, word, both tongues): «20% of 80 is 16», the conversion percent<->hundredths, the inverse question «16 is 20% of 80», and growth and cut by a percent; only whole results are uttered — a percent that does not come out whole is not shown at all

worlds.name: average
worlds.genre: the summary of a row: average with its GROUND beside it (the sum and the count named separately), largest and smallest, the law that the average lies between them, and the counterexample that the average need not be one of the numbers

worlds.name: equation
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry on equations: what a root IS, a case DECIDED by substitution with the arithmetic beside the verdict, Vieta shown as sum and product of the roots rather than a formula recited, a refusal with its ground («no whole root between 0 and 10: every value leaves a remainder»), and the square root as the INVERSE surface of the square; coefficients derived from the roots, numbers by range and not by case

worlds.name: equation_signed
worlds.genre: the same ladder of equations where roots may be NEGATIVE or zero — kept a world apart, not because the mathematics differs but because a frame is bought only when ONE performer speaks on EVERY show of it: a solver living in the unsigned world cannot reproduce «is -6 a root», and one such show kills the purchase of the whole frame

worlds.name: dataformat
worlds.genre: data formats: ONE flat record written in JSON, YAML, TOML and CSV and said in two tongues, with the conversion between them as the show; the court parses both sides with its own readers and requires the SAME RECORD, not the same string — two writings differ in every character and mean one thing, which is what a format IS; the boundary is declared: flat records only, because nesting is held differently by every format and not at all by CSV

worlds.name: everyday
worlds.genre: everyday life, and every line of it CARRIES A COMPUTABLE GROUND: things counted, containment walked through a declared tree, time ordered by a declared row, the past of a verb by rule with irregulars named, comparison by subtraction, and what remains after spending — the world that pays the debt named by the reach measure, where the corpus was rich in structure and poor in words

worlds.name: story_chain
worlds.genre: the three-part chain: one bearer, one thing, THREE different verbs in ONE show — «Tom picked 12 apples and gave away 5; Tom keeps 7 apples». A market law is bought only inside one episode, so the law lives in the show or it does not live; the third fact carries its bearer explicitly, both polarities are shown, and the polarity is declared BY THE VERBS, not read off the numbers

worlds.name: age
worlds.genre: age and the shift of time: the difference between two ages does NOT change when both move forward or back — the law a corpus of single facts cannot teach; ages now, the shift in both directions, the multiple relation with its ground, the multiple in the future built so it is true by construction, and a refusal when nothing is said about the person asked

worlds.name: share
worlds.genre: shares said in WORDS: «two thirds», «три четверти», the share of a quantity with its ground («12 divided by 3 is 4, and 4 times 2 is 8»), the share in comparison («half as many»), mixed numbers («one and a half»), and shares that add to one whole; only whole results are uttered

worlds.name: compare_mult
worlds.genre: multiple comparison, and the two frames English keeps apart standing SIDE BY SIDE ON THE SAME NUMBERS: «as many as» for the countable and «as much as» for the uncountable — the organism had bought one and not the other because they never stood together; plus worded multipliers (twice, thrice) beside the numeric ones, «N times more than» with its ground, and the difference comparison next to the multiple one so the two are told apart

worlds.name: lang_el
worlds.genre: greek: the corpus's third alphabet, three genders, and the accent as an OBLIGATORY sign — a word without it is a different word (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ar
worlds.genre: arabic: written RIGHT TO LEFT, with a DUAL number — a third count form beside singular and plural — and teens said as two words (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_hi
worlds.genre: hindi: devanagari, the corpus's first ABUGIDA — a vowel is a MARK ON the consonant, not a letter beside it; the pack is declared SPACED, which is the truth about the language, and the instrument was taught to read a combining mark as a letter by office (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ja
worlds.genre: japanese: three scripts in one line, counters instead of number agreement, and NO plural at all (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ko
worlds.genre: korean: hangul, where a sign is BUILT from letters; particles instead of cases, chosen by whether the word ends in a consonant (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_sw
worlds.genre: swahili: NOUN CLASSES, where the class of the noun governs the PREFIX of verb, adjective and numeral alike — agreement that changes the BEGINNING of a word, not its end (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_th
worlds.genre: thai: written without spaces between words but WITH spaces between sentences — a third case the segmenter did not have; tone marks above the consonant and vowels written before it (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_vi
worlds.genre: vietnamese: six tones by diacritic, where ma, mà, má, mả, mã, mạ are six different words; a word written in syllables separated by spaces (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_fa
worlds.genre: persian: the ARABIC SCRIPT on an INDO-EUROPEAN language — the probe that asks whether we tied a language to its writing; no dual, no arabic 3–10 agreement, four letters of its own (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_he
worlds.genre: hebrew: written right to left and WITHOUT VOWELS in ordinary writing — the opposite pole of the abugida, where a vowel is a mark ON the consonant; a dual on some words and gender on the numerals (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_fi
worlds.genre: finnish: FIFTEEN CASES said by ENDING, not by preposition, and CONSONANT GRADATION that changes the STEM (kukka → kukan) rather than the suffix (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_hu
worlds.genre: hungarian: vowel harmony in three sets, possessive suffixes instead of possessive pronouns, and DEFINITE VS INDEFINITE CONJUGATION — the verb changes by the DEFINITENESS OF ITS OBJECT, which no other tongue of the corpus has (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_id
worlds.genre: indonesian: the SIMPLEST of them all, and that is its value — no tense, no gender, no case, no agreement at all; the plural is the word said TWICE (buku-buku). The probe on EMPTINESS: an engine that demands some agreement finds none here (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ka
worlds.genre: georgian: the corpus's fifth script (mkhedruli), WITH NO CAPITAL LETTERS AT ALL — a probe on every place we lower a case or compare one — and a verb carrying BOTH subject and object in one form (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_am
worlds.genre: amharic: the sixth script, ethiopic, where a sign carries the consonant TOGETHER WITH its vowel — not a mark beside it but part of the sign itself, and there are some 270 of them (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ta
worlds.genre: tamil: an abugida like hindi but with its OWN marks — the direct second test of the law that a combining mark is a letter by office; it passed with plain spaced cutting and NO change to the instrument. Also an INCLUSIVE and an EXCLUSIVE «we», a seventh person (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: inquiry_de_fr
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry in GERMAN and FRENCH: the same four rungs — definition, a case decided with its ground beside the verdict, a counterexample, the law — carried into tongues that until now could only count and decline. Twenty-nine languages could COUNT; two could REASON, and that gap was wider than eight more packs

worlds.name: inquiry_es_it
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry in SPANISH and ITALIAN, with the marks those tongues require and no others: the inverted question mark that opens a Spanish question, and the accent that separates «sí» from «si»

worlds.name: inquiry_pt_nl
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry in PORTUGUESE and DUTCH: the same four rungs — definition, a case decided with its ground beside the verdict, a counterexample, the law — carried into a Romance tongue that marks the question by INTONATION ALONE (no inverted mark, unlike Spanish) and a Germanic one that inverts the verb; the ladder mechanism is unchanged, which is what makes a new tongue cost a line and not a layer

worlds.name: inquiry_pl_tr
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry in POLISH and TURKISH, where the QUESTION ITSELF STOPS BEING PUNCTUATION: Polish asks with a WORD («czy»), Turkish with a SEPARATE PARTICLE at the end that AGREES BY VOWEL HARMONY with the word before it — four written forms of one particle, and the court DERIVES the form from the word rather than checking it against a list

worlds.name: relation
worlds.genre: metalanguage of structure in both languages: hierarchy (a declared tree of 18 nodes — containment, level, path from the root), relations on a finite set with reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity each shown WITH a confirming case and WITH a named witness of violation, transitive closure, equivalence and classes (remainders modulo 3 and 4 on 1..12), correspondence one-to-one and not, order with incomparable elements and no greatest element, connection and path in a directed graph with refusals grounded, and distance as a space; every claim is WALKED by the court, and the oracle of each kind is two opposite walks (level up against depth down, witness against set algebra, remainder buckets against connected pieces, the order rule against reachability over covers, a walk forward against a walk backward)

worlds.name: metalang
worlds.genre: the METALANGUAGE OF PROOF in both tongues, where every word stands at content the court recomputes: a THEOREM with its CONDITION and CONCLUSION named at numbers, a DEFINITION with a case under it and a case refused, an AXIOM taken without proof, a LEMMA shown at work inside the proof it serves, a PROOF as a chain whose every link is recounted, a COROLLARY by reapplying the theorem and by its special case, a HYPOTHESIS with its fate (Euler's n*n+n+41 prime for forty values and dead at the forty-first; Goldbach confirmed by a case and proved by none), and a COUNTEREXAMPLE with the law that a confirming case does not save. The whole world is derived from one pair: a number's kind is (divisor, remainder)

worlds.name: longdiv
worlds.genre: LONG DIVISION AS A WALK, NOT A NUMBER — ordered by the band, not by us: `band_reach` found that atlas asks «391 ÷ 17 =» and «5236 ÷ 17 =» while neither number stood once in 194392 lines of shows. Every step of the division is its own checkable equality (take 39; 17 × 2 = 34; 39 − 34 = 5; bring down 1 — 51; 17 × 3 = 51; remainder 0), the ZERO in the middle of a quotient is shown rather than skipped (5236 ÷ 17 = 308), the INVERSE ROAD is a built-in oracle (23 × 17 = 391, and quotient × divisor + remainder = dividend), the refusal is BRACKETED BY TWO COMPUTED MULTIPLES («391 ÷ 19 gives no whole: 19 × 20 = 380, and 19 × 21 = 399 is more than 391»), and column multiplication names its partial products. Divisor and quotient come by range, the dividend is DERIVED as their product; both glyphs of division are written, since two different bands recognise the genus by different ones

worlds.name: ru_conversions
worlds.genre: unit conversion in the RUSSIAN question frame: «сколько минут в двух часах?» — the numeral stands in an oblique case and the unit after it in the prepositional, forms the corpus never showed; every answer carries its GROUND beside the verdict («в часе 60 минут, 60 × 2 = 120»), the ratio is asked of the declared unit graph and never written by hand, the same relation is shown FORWARD by multiplication and BACKWARD by division on the same numbers, and a question across incommensurable units is refused with the ground the court can re-ask of the graph

worlds.name: ru_compare
worlds.genre: multiplicative against differential comparison in Russian: «во сколько раз больше» is DIVISION and «на сколько больше» is SUBTRACTION, two frames a speaker confuses more often than any other, shown on the SAME pair of numbers side by side with the difference between them named aloud; the price frame carries both measures at once; the multiplicative question without a whole answer is refused with the division-with-remainder as its ground, while the differential question on the same pair still answers — which is itself the proof that the frames are two

worlds.name: ru_story
worlds.genre: Russian word problems as EPISODES: one bearer, one thing, an action and a total, where the third fact names its bearer EXPLICITLY («у пети осталось 5 яблок») because a market law is bought only inside one episode; loss and gain share one structure with opposite sign and the Russian turn of phrase follows the sign («отдал … осталось», «купил … стало»); the question surface asks the total instead of stating it, and a question about a person the problem never named is refused with the ground that the court re-checks against the bearer

worlds.name: notationvar
worlds.genre: one sign, two scripts: the same record written in ASCII and in typography, and the court reduces both to one canon. The corpus knew every sign in ONE script only, and in different signs — in DIFFERENT ones: «x^2» 1702 times and «x²» ZERO, «≤» 351 and «<=» ZERO. worlds.name: school
worlds.genre: the school assembly: every world that declares «school» in its `assemblies`, in manifest order — the ladder a learner walks before the whole corpus; a consequence of the manifest, not a decision of whoever assembles it

worlds.name: full
worlds.genre: the full mix: every world of shows, in manifest order, welded by the same seam that welds passes inside a layer — a consequence of the manifest, not a decision of whoever assembles it

worlds.name: minimal
worlds.genre: the minimal assembly: every world of shows in manifest order, cut to NINE shows per GENUS (the second step of the census skeleton — numbers and numerals «#», declared names «@», the fillers of the houses of phrases, the words of fractions and multiplicity «※»). The owner's question of 03.09 — how minimal may the corpus be — has a number from the census (Σ min(mass, 9) by genus, 42 % of the lines) and now a FILE: an organism taught on this assembly must answer as much as one taught on the full one, or the difference is the price of mass. What is kept: the seams, the order and the names of the worlds, every genus up to nine shows; what is lost: the variety of NUMBERS beyond nine shows — the very thing the census calls weight and an executor may call knowledge. Built by scripts/minimal_build.py

worlds.name: uniq
worlds.genre: the assembly WITHOUT REPEATS: every world of shows in manifest order, with the second and every further EXACT COPY of a line of the SAME world struck out. The measure that asked for it (d5, 04.09) is stronger than the weight it saves: if the measures on this assembly equal the measures on the full one, then half the svod IS NOT BOUGHT — a statement about the nature of buying, not about build time; if they differ, the repeat IS bought, and it is a law and not a debt. Three conditions of a clean trial are kept: the deduplication is WITHIN a world (a line met in two different worlds is a coincidence of worlds, not a repeat of a pass), the ORDER of lines is preserved (the page is the organism's unit, and a permutation changes neighbourhoods — only the second and further copies are struck, the first stays in its place), and a per-world report stands beside the assembly so that a divergence of measures can be attributed to a world. WHAT THIS ASSEMBLY IS NOT (d5's correction, 04.09, under М-198 «the ground may not be wider than the subject»): it narrows not the AREA OF THE GROUND but the SUBJECT itself, and therefore it is NOT a cure for the non-locality of a market — it answers one question only, whether mass is bought by identical lines, and promises nothing else. Measured the same day: without the repeats, the genera of the worst worlds fall below LAW² almost entirely (lang_de 82 → 270 genera under the law, lang_sw 12 → 163), so the repeat does not carry a new line but does carry the MASS of its genus — and mass is what a law is bought with.

worlds.name: mid13
worlds.genre: the assembly cut to 13 shows per GENUS — a point of the CURVE OF SUFFICIENCY (holon 03.09, after the price of mass was measured: on nine shows per genus the attack lost 13 answers, twenty points of coverage, four fifths of depth-2 chains and all of depth 3; so the corpus is cut again at thirteen and at twenty, and the same binary runs on 9 → 13 → 20 → full). The census measures the VISIBILITY of a genus; the purchase of a chain measures its LEARNABILITY, and the second wants mass. Built by scripts/minimal_build.py --масса 13

worlds.name: selfmeasure

worlds.name: space

worlds.name: stenogram

worlds.name: mathspaces

worlds.name: pronouns
worlds.genre: the pronoun genus (e9's order 03.09, SVAMP band: the pronoun market buys a word as a pronoun from pages of three sentences «X V1 N. <pron> V2 M. X V3 K» with K = N ± M, and without this genus it bought names standing second): pages of three sentences in one line — the person named first, the pronoun second (he/she by the declared gender of the name in en.json person_forms, they for two persons; then he / later she / he also), the name again third with the result; the question surface asks BY NAME and answers with the equation («paco had 25 cookies. he ate 5 of them. how many cookies does paco have? 25 − 5 = 20.»); four verb triples with sign — loss with «of them» / «из них», gain with «more» / «ещё»; Russian pages with он/она/они and the genitive of the name from ru.json person_forms («у Вани было 25 печений. потом он съел 5 из них. у Вани осталось 20 печений.»); the pronoun never opens a page; the court checks the pronoun against gender and number of persons, the third name against the first, the verb triple and recomputes K
